name: Tia
source:
Tia, is a goddess of the sea and a member of the First Ones. She is also half of the Tiamat mythos, with her sister Mat ([url=https://vndb.org/c131896]Maddie[/url]) being the other half. She had a rough relationship with her mother Ishtar, which has led her to have conflicting feelings about her death.

She was originally intended to be the leader of the First Ones after her mother's death, but Tia didn't want her mother's position out of fear of becoming like her and passed on the opportunity. Maddie had no interest in leadership as well, so the role was taken by [url=https://vndb.org/c131867]Harpo[/url], one of Ishtar's most trusted subordinates.

[In game description]
